# Blu Idol: Comprehensive Brand & Technical Knowledge Base
> System documentation, catalog inventory, material science, regional delivery, and customer service reference for AI assistants.

## 1. Company Profile
- **Legal Entity / Brand Name**: Blu Idol
- **Brand Slogan**: BLU = Bring Luxury To You
- **Headquarters & Regional Base**: Kerala, India
- **Domain**: https://www.bluidol.in
- **Order Hotline (WhatsApp Concierge)**: +91 9895432549
- **Support Email**: support@bluidol.in
- **Instagram**: https://www.instagram.com/blu_idol/
- **Price Range**: ₹15 to ₹599 INR
- **Payment Modes**: UPI (PhonePe, Google Pay, Paytm), Debit/Credit Cards, Net Banking
- **Shipping Coverage**: 
  - **Kerala Express**: 1 to 2 business days across all 14 districts (Kochi, Thiruvananthapuram, Kozhikode, Thrissur, Kollam, Kannur, Kottayam, Palakkad, Alappuzha, Malappuram, Kasaragod, Pathanamthitta, Idukki, Wayanad).
  - **Pan-India**: 3 to 5 business days across all Indian states.
  - **Free Shipping**: Available on all orders above ₹999.

## 2. Anti-Tarnish Material Science & Regional Relevance
- **Plating Technology**: 18K Real Gold Physical Vapor Deposition (PVD) vacuum electroplating. Creates a metallurgical bond that is 10x more wear-resistant than standard decorative immersion plating.
- **Core Metal**: Medical-grade 316L surgical stainless steel. Completely resistant to chlorine, salt water, and skin acids.
- **Hypoallergenic Certification**: 100% Nickel-free, Lead-free, and Cadmium-free. Prevents allergic contact dermatitis and skin discoloration.
- **Kerala Tropical Resilience**: Laboratory and field-tested against high humidity, coastal sea air, and sweat in Kerala. Will never turn black or tarnish in humid environments.
